gloss: side income; extra earnings; supplementary income

definitions.gloss: side income; extra earnings; supplementary income
definitions.explanation: Income earned in addition to one's main salary or primary source of income. Includes money from side jobs, investments, freelance work, or any other secondary earning activity.

examples.japanese: {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}を{得|え}たい。
examples.english: I want to earn some side income.

examples.japanese: ブログで{月|つき}に{数万円|すうまんえん}の{副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}がある。
examples.english: I earn a side income of tens of thousands of yen per month from my blog.

examples.japanese: {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}が{年間|ねんかん}20{万円|まんえん}を{超|こ}えると{確定申告|かくていしんこく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: If your side income exceeds 200,000 yen per year, you need to file a tax return.

notes:
Income earned outside of one's primary job. The topic of {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう} has become increasingly popular in Japan as more people look for ways to supplement their salary through side jobs ({副業|ふくぎょう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}を{得|え}る: to earn side income
- {副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}を{稼|かせ}ぐ: to make extra money
- {月|つき}〜{円|えん}の{副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}: side income of ~ yen per month
- {安定|あんてい}した{副収入|ふくしゅうにゅう}: stable side income

SOURCES OF SIDE INCOME:
- {副業|ふくぎょう}: side job, side business
- {投資|とうし}: investment income
- {不動産|ふどうさん}{収入|しゅうにゅう}: rental income
- アフィリエイト: affiliate marketing

RELATED WORDS:
- {副業|ふくぎょう}: side job — the work itself, rather than the income it generates
- {本業|ほんぎょう}: main job, primary occupation
- {不労所得|ふろうしょとく}: unearned income, passive income
